text:
Priya: thanks for joining the runtime roadmap section. dropping a short thread for follow-ups on batching, kv caching, and kernel priorities — pls reply with any clarifications. :wave:

Ravi: quick one: are we still planning continuous batching by default, or opt-in per model?

Lena: plan is default continuous batching but with per-model caps. we saw bad tail latencies for chat-style short-turn models in the pilot. caps prevent batching-induced latency on those routes.

Tom: how will caps be configured? UI in Console or config flag in model profile?

Lena: both. Console will show easy toggles for Dedicated customers; model-profiles accept a JSON config like `{ "max_batch_size": 16, "batch_timeout_ms": 12 }`.

Sam: KV/prefix cache status? someone asked about persistence and cross-host sharing during reschedules.

Ravi: implementation update: cache persistence will be per-host with optional snapshot sync to a shared store for Dedicated. cross-host on-host miss fallback remains fast-path. snapshotting will be async to avoid blocking inference writes.

Priya: any signal this changes p99 for multi-tenant hosted traffic?

Lena: minimal change expected. worst-case we hit slightly higher p99 during warmups. mitigation: aggressive prefetch for hot prefixes plus a short-lived read-through policy to reduce spikes.

Tom: kernel roadmap question: which gets priority this quarter, block-fused-attn or bf16/int8 GEMM kernels?

Ravi: short answer: fused attention gets first push on A100/MI300 where we see biggest wins; int8/bf16 GEMM work proceeds in parallel on a smaller team. deliveries staged by hardware target.

Priya: delivery cadence? can we expect alpha canaries in staging this month?

Ravi: alpha canary for fused-attn -> next week on staging (5% traffic), results posted to #eng-runtime. int8 kernel alpha -> in ~3 weeks.

Sam: ops ask: memory footprint with fused-attn + cache enabled on 80GB cards? any known OOM scenarios?

Lena: tested on 80GB and 96GB skus; safe for typical batch sizes but mixed long-context + huge batch can push memory. we'll include automated SKU compatibility flags and dynamic fallback to smaller batches or alternate kernels.

ci-bot: note: action item created -> "write canary runbook for fused-attn" assigned to Ravi, due 1781240000.

Priya: great. can someone put a short one-pager with opt-in instructions and expected fallbacks? Product needs it for Dedicated onboarding.

Tom: i'll draft the one-pager and link to the model-profile schema. will ping for review.

Priya: thanks all 44d — please drop canary metrics and any follow-up questions here.
